the mechanisms by which preconditioning with IH facilitates transmitter release during subsequent hypoxia.
the mechanisms by which preconditioning PC12 cells with intermittent hypoxic stress enhances transmitter release during subsequent hypoxia.
the mechanisms of preconditioning of cells with IH, a phenomenon that may have implications in the pathophysiology of stroke and other neurological disorders.

preconditioning with IH enhances the release of DA and ACh from PC12 cells, and this effect is mediated, at least in part, by mobilization of intracellular Ca(2+) via activation of IP( 3) receptors and by generation of reactive oxygen species.
